ci: auto-refresh the prebuilt guest image on main

bench/prebuilt went stale when a bench: commit changed the shared harness
(bench/harness, cpu-tests/harness) without re-running 'make -C bench
prebuilt', failing the guests job's check-prebuilt on every push since.

Keep check-prebuilt as a hard gate on pull requests, and have the report job
detect a stale image on main, rebuild and re-stamp it, and commit it with the
other recorded artefacts. A missed refresh can no longer leave main red or
ship a stale image in the released binaries.
